meta.description: Thapsus-HR is the simpler, fairer HR platform for growing companies across the UK, EU and US.

hero.eyebrow: HR for the UK, EU and US
hero.title: People, time and compliance. Calmly handled.
hero.lead: One place for employee records, time off, rotas and the rules of every country you hire in, with your data kept in the region you choose.

regions.uk: Data stays in London, with backups across availability zones.
regions.eu: Data stays in Frankfurt; backup copies only within the EU.
regions.us: Data stays in Ohio; backup copies only within the US.

features.title: Everything HR needs, nothing it does not.
features.lead: Built for ten people or two hundred thousand, with the same calm interface.

people.title: People and organisation
people.body: Effective-dated records, multiple legal entities and an org chart that stays fast at any size.

timeOff.title: Time off and absence
timeOff.body: Policies per country, public holidays, sickness tracking and statutory rules kept current.

rota.title: Rotas and time
rota.body: Build rotas, swap shifts and clock in from any phone, with working-time rules built in.

compliance.title: Compliance centre
compliance.body: Right to work, I-9, pay transparency and more, with a feed of what changed and what to do.

residency.title: Your data stays in your region.
residency.body: Choose where your company lives when you sign up. Every record, file, backup and email for your people stays there.

pricing.title: Transparent pricing
pricing.body: Published prices by company size. Monthly plans you can leave at any time.

export.title: Your data, always
export.body: Export everything whenever you like, in open formats.

support.title: Real people
support.body: Responsive human support, with clear response times on every plan.

cta.title: Bring calm to HR in an afternoon.
